CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Private Sub cmdExit_Click()
    'closes forms switchboard
    Msg = "Do you really want to close the database and Microsoft Access?"
    Style = vbYesNo + vbQuestion
    Title = "Close Microsoft Access"
    Response = MsgBox(Msg, Style, Title)

    If Response = vbNo Then
        Cancel = True
    Else
        Application.Quit acPrompt
    End If
End Sub

    Dim DocName As String
    Dim LinkCriteria As String

    DocName = "Contacts"
    DoCmd.OpenForm DocName, , , LinkCriteria
End Sub

    Dim LinkCriteria As String

    DocName = "Opening Balance"
    DoCmd.OpenForm DocName, , , LinkCriteria

End Sub

Private Sub transactions_button_Click()

    Dim LinkCriteria As String

    DocName = "transactions"
    DoCmd.OpenForm DocName, , , LinkCriteria

End Sub

Dim DocName As String

    DocName = "TransactionsDialogBox"
